acceptance_criteria: The function correctly counts lines that are not empty (i.e., lines with at least one non-whitespace character).
Empty lines (e.g., lines containing only whitespace or newlines) are not counted.
The function handles edge cases such as empty input or input with only whitespace.

text.description: The input text to analyze for non-empty lines.

objective: Count the number of non-empty lines in a supplied text string.

line_count.description: The number of non-empty lines in the input text.
